settings.title: Built on Experience. Designed for Today.
settings.text: Polycraft Industries has spent more than three decades manufacturing moulded furniture in Pakistan under the Fello brand — starting with a single chair mould and growing into one of the country's established moulded furniture makers.

settings.title: From One Mould to a Full Range
Why the Resin Matters
settings.text:
Fello furniture is made using 100% virgin furniture-grade polypropylene resin.

Every product passes through strict quality control before it reaches a showroom floor.
